manifest.description: Technical HATVP fact-checking report for statistical asset outliers in snapshot 2026-08-17.

query.description: Joins assets, quarantine anomalies, people, and declarations on declaration_uuid; selects robust statistical asset outliers for snapshot 2026-08-17.
query.sql: WITH flagged_assets AS (SELECT declaration_uuid, source_section, source_item_index, asset_name, raw_value, normalized_value FROM read_parquet('gs://yahatvp-pipeline-eu-data/hatvp/silver/assets/snapshot_date=2026-08-17/data.parquet') WHERE quality_reason LIKE 'robust statistical asset outlier%') SELECT a.*, p.civilite, p.prenom, p.nom, d.date_depot AS publication_date FROM flagged_assets a LEFT JOIN read_parquet('gs://yahatvp-pipeline-eu-data/hatvp/silver/people/snapshot_date=2026-08-17/data.parquet') p USING (declaration_uuid) LEFT JOIN read_parquet('gs://yahatvp-pipeline-eu-data/hatvp/silver/declarations/snapshot_date=2026-08-17/data.parquet') d USING (declaration_uuid) ORDER BY a.normalized_value DESC
filters: quality_reason = robust statistical asset outlier; retained for review

Outlier share = flagged euro-denominated row-value sum divided by numeric euro-denominated asset row-value sum.
All monetary values are euro-denominated; publication_date is normalized declarations.date_depot.

blocks.body:
# Statistical asset outliers

## Technical summary

The pipeline flagged 143 asset rows as statistical outliers among 1,156 numeric euro-denominated asset rows (12.4%). All 143 are high-side outliers, ranging from €192,252 to €6,719,662.

The flagged rows sum to €99,617,179, compared with €124,440,950 across all numeric euro-denominated asset values. Every flagged row matched a declarant name and normalized publication date through declaration_uuid, so the register supports source-level fact checking. This is not a share of household wealth: rows may represent partial interests, overlapping declarations, or different valuation concepts.

## Scope and metric definitions

The report covers the successful HATVP snapshot dated 2026-08-17. The asset table contains 1,376 rows, of which 1,156 have numeric normalized values. Monetary values are euros. The detector uses median absolute deviation (MAD): robust scale = 1.4826 × MAD, and rows with an absolute robust z-score above 10 are retained as review flags. Publication date means normalized declarations.date_depot from the source XML; the raw source deposit timestamp remains available in date_depot_raw.

## Real estate contributes most flagged rows

Real estate contributes 86 of the 143 flagged rows (60.1%) and €57,222,895 of flagged euro-denominated row value. Life insurance contributes 30 rows (21.0%). The distribution is a review prioritization signal, not evidence that any category or declarant is incorrect.

## Most flagged rows fall below €1 million

The €250k–€500k band contains 52 rows, while 25 rows are at or above €1 million. The two values above €5 million are the duplicated FINAPA entries associated with M. Serge Papin; both should be checked against the source declaration and ownership context.

## Highest-value declaration groups are the best fact-check starting points

The highest-value groups are M. Serge Papin on 2025-12-05 and 2026-02-17, Mme Rachida Dati on 2026-04-22, M. Jean-Noel Barrot on 2025-12-05 and 2026-02-25, and Mme Monique BARBUT on 2025-11-13 and 2026-03-22. Use the declarant, normalized publication date, and declaration UUID together when locating the corresponding source declaration or PDF.

## Full outlier register

The register below keeps the exact declaration UUID, declarant, normalized publication date, source section, asset name, normalized euro value, raw source value, and source item index. Names are joined by declaration_uuid; repeated names are not treated as unique identities.

## Methodology

The robust outlier check is descriptive, not inferential. It compares each numeric assets.normalized_value against the snapshot median and MAD. Suspicious rows are retained for review; they are not silently removed or corrected. The 143 rows represent 69 distinct declaration UUIDs, and five flagged rows have no asset name.

## Limitations and uncertainty

A statistical flag does not establish that a value is wrong, illicit, duplicated, or misparsed. High values may reflect partial ownership, valuation conventions, source duplication, or legitimate wealth. The report does not independently verify an external public-web publication timestamp; it uses the normalized declaration deposit date from the XML.

## Recommended next steps

1. Start with the highest-value rows and grouped declarations above.
2. Use declarant name, normalized publication date, and declaration UUID to locate the HATVP source declaration or PDF.
3. Compare the displayed euro value with the source field and inspect ownership share, valuation date, asset type, and related declarations.
4. Record confirmed source issues as fixtures or normalization fixes; retain plausible high values as review flags.

## Further questions

The next useful review cuts are whether the same UUIDs recur across declaration versions, whether large values are concentrated in particular asset DTO fields, and whether source-level ownership percentages explain repeated or apparently duplicated euro values.

## Source artifacts

The report is based on the normalized assets, people, and declarations Parquet tables plus the quarantine anomalies Parquet for snapshot 2026-08-17. The pipeline quality report is stored alongside the snapshot in GCS.
